name: Ms. Match
source:
You're a bartender in New York City with a talent for turning lonely hearts into happy couples. Tonight, is it finally your turn to find romance?

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Ms._Match]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
你是纽约市的一名调酒师，拥有将孤独的心变成幸福情侣的天赋。今晚，终于轮到你寻找浪漫了吗？

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Ms._Match]Choices Wikia[/url]]
